extractor: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code session), 1 sample per cell

states.S0: Before enable_s1: UE powered on in 5GMM-DEREGISTERED, no NAS signalling connection.
states.S1: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED: REGISTRATION REQUEST sent for initial registration; no 5G NAS security context; not authenticated on this connection.
states.S2: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED: 5G AKA completed (new KAMF in a partial native 5G NAS security context); secure exchange of NAS messages NOT yet established (no SECURITY MODE COMMAND accepted).
states.S3: 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED: SECURITY MODE COMMAND accepted, secure exchange of NAS messages established; REGISTRATION ACCEPT not yet received.
states.S4: 5GMM-REGISTERED: REGISTRATION ACCEPT processed (REGISTRATION COMPLETE sent); secure exchange of NAS messages established.
states.S5: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED after a network-initiated de-registration completed; NAS signalling connection released.
